title: Fix Structure Mode right-click + auto-highlight feedback
description:
Right-click on nodes in the Structure Mode floating list was swallowed by the PDF board context-menu suppressor (the float sits over the plan, so document capture stopped the event before the list menu could open). That is fixed so Edit name / highline / Force redraw work again.

Force redraw auto-highlights was also failing silently because it used an incomplete Plan View context. It now calls the same full auto-highlight path as Plan Sync, shows a toast immediately, and writes a status line in the Structure panel (working / success / error).

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map31).
changeLog: Allow Structure Mode list right-click menu to open over the PDF board.
Force redraw uses full Plan Sync auto-highlight context (no silent failure).
Toast + in-panel status message while/after redrawing auto-highlights.
